# SLAM.SYSTEMS_FTP_UPLOAD_v1.6

The WeCom path on the Mac cannot be mounted here. This is the published equivalent of that ZIP, taken from:

https://slam.systems/SLAM.SYSTEMS_FTP_UPLOAD_v1.6/

Recursive wget and a 400-path brute-force of images/videos/pdfs found **no extra media**. The ZIP/FTP package only contains the files below.

| File | Bytes | How the live site uses it |
|---|---:|---|
| index.html | 5993 | Homepage structure and copy |
| media-playout.html | 23053 | COR / DS product copy |
| led-video-systems.html | 15338 | SMD / COB / Peripherals copy |
| solutions.html | 8364 | Cloud / Training / Custom Made copy |
| company.html | 7863 | Company / philosophy / partners copy |
| start-project.html | 4035 | Contact form copy |
| assets/css/styles.css | 22514 | Visual system; vertical-only nav hover |
| assets/js/site-navigation.js | 3410 | Mega-nav product tree |
| assets/js/product-content.js | 2041 | Weiterlesen / Keyfigures |
| assets/logos/logo_slam.systems-1920-(ff004e)(bg-bkl).png | 28192 | Header, footer, favicon |
| assets/images/handball-hero-master-v1-scoreboard-correct.png | 2032219 | Hero theme 01 — original file, not regenerated |
| assets/fonts/Goodtime/good-times-rg.otf | 22476 | Display font |
| assets/fonts/Avenir/Avenir Next.ttc | 4988788 | Body font (`assets/fonts/Avenir/AvenirNext.ttc`) |

Product photographs added under `assets/images/from-slam-systems/` come from the live slam.systems site, not from this ZIP (the ZIP has none besides the handball hero).
